info.name: Get results for a single document

params.name: parserId
params.description: The unique identifier of the document parser.

params.name: documentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the document.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format for parsed results. "object" (recommended) returns structured JSON; "flat" returns a flat key-value map.

items.docs: Retrieves the parsed data for a specific document. Rate limited to 60 calls per minute.

info.name: Get results for all documents in a parser

params.name: parserId
params.description: The unique identifier of the document parser.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format for parsed results. "object" (recommended) returns structured JSON; "flat" returns a flat key-value map.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: date
params.description: Filter results to documents processed after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: remote_id
params.description: Filter results by remote_id assigned at upload.

params.name: include_processing_queue
params.description: Include documents still in the processing queue.

items.docs: Retrieves parsed data for multiple documents belonging to the specified parser. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination. Rate limited to 30 calls per minute.
